title: NetPerfMeterProtocol dissector improvements
description:
- Added detection of NetPerfMeterProtocol over TCP, UDP and DCCP by analysing the payload to reliably detect the NetPerfMeterProtocol.
- Added an example trace with NetPerfMeter over SCTP, TCP, UDP and DCCP in test/captures/netperfmeter.pcap.gz.
